Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Return correct text unchanged.", "input": "Maya: morning all, i pulled the screen-reader audit notes into the shared doc. this is for the new account setup and checkout flow on desktop and mobile, not the older billing pages. the audit ran on the staging build from tuesday, and i added the browser, device, and screen-reader version beside each finding so we can reproduce them. please use this thread for decisions; the doc is getting pretty busy and a couple comments there are just questions.

Priya: on iPhone, VoiceOver announces the password button before the help link, which matches the visual order. i tried both Safari and the in-app browser; same result in each. one separate thing: the “Show password” control changes to “Hide password,” but VoiceOver doesn't announce that the state changed. the visible label updates, so this isn't the same focus-order finding. i added a short recording and the exact steps to the doc.

Rafael: i checked the markup in staging. the error text has an id, but the input doesn't reference it with aria-describedby after submit. the required state is announced before submit, so that part seems okay. i can't tell from this build whether the same issue is in the release branch. i'll ask the web team for the branch comparison, and i can take the markup fix if they confirm it's isolated to setup.

Tess: quick status from my pass on checkout with JAWS and Chrome. the cart summary heading is announced, and the item count updates after removing a product. the remove button names are all just “Remove,” though, so with two products i can't tell which one i'm about to remove. the product names are visible next to the buttons but aren't included in their accessible names. i logged this separately from the setup form issues.
